preconditions.description: The number of people n must be between 1 and 100,000.
The number of imbalanced people k must be between 0 and n.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'NO' if k > n // 2 else stdout.startswith('YES')
postconditions.description: If k is greater than half of n, output NO; otherwise, output YES followed by the construction.

postconditions.expression: len(s) == n and all(0 <= s[i] <= n for i in range(n))
postconditions.description: The output list s must have n elements, each representing the child of the corresponding person, with values between 0 and n.

postconditions.expression: sum(1 for i in range(n) if s[i] != 0) == n - 1
postconditions.description: Exactly one person must have no children, represented by a 0 in the output list.
